C1193.title: Changsha Yuhua Court Sentences Operator of an Online SMS Bombing Service
C1193.summary: From March to September 2023, Li operated a Taobao store selling telephone and SMS bombing services and taught the method to others. One attack sent a victim 24 nuisance calls and more than 200 verification messages within five minutes. The Changsha Yuhua District Court convicted Li of disrupting computer information systems and teaching criminal methods, imposed a combined ten-month prison term suspended for one year, and confiscated 10,000 yuan in illegal proceeds.
